text:
Elena (marcom): Heads-up — we99re seeing a partial service interruption in eu-west affecting embeddings latency. Telemetry spike started ~1 min ago. Can marketing standby for customer-facing comms? Need: channel matrix, timing, and a couple short status snippets.
Maya (growth): On it. Can you share scope (percent of customers, which plans)? Also recommend holding outbound webinar reminder emails until we99ve stabilized.
Liam (ops): Rough scope: ~12% of embedding requests, mostly small batch jobs on Dedicated. No data loss, just high latency. Root cause suspected NVLink congestion; engineers are shifting traffic now. ETA for mitigation ~20–30m but could be sooner.
Elena (marcom): Ok - propose initial push at T+10m: post to status page and in-app banner for affected regions. Email to customers on Dedicated + Enterprise at T+20m if still degraded. Social/X only after status page goes live.
Maya (growth): Agree. Quick channel matrix suggestion:
- Status page: immediate, public
- In-app banner: immediate for affected orgs
- Email to Dedicated/Enterprise: T+20m if not resolved
- Webinar reminder/promo emails: HOLD until resolved (pause in Mailer queue)
- Sales routing: route inbound high-touch leads to CSM queue with "Potential Impact" flag
Liam (ops): +1. Ops will push statuspage draft to the incident ticket. ops-bot: incident/176012 triggered with link: https://incidents.internal/r/176012 (bot auto-update enabled).
ops-bot: Automated update: mitigation started, routing shift in progress. Next auto-update at 10m.
Maya (growth): Draft statuspage snippet for review: 
"We are currently experiencing elevated latency for embedding requests in the eu-west region. Our engineers have identified a networking throughput issue and are actively shifting traffic and applying mitigations. There is no evidence of data loss. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or as more information becomes available."
Elena (marcom): Nice. Shortened email subject options: 1) "Service update: eu-west latency affecting embeddings" 2) "We99re addressing higher latency in eu-west — quick update". Preference for #2 (softer tone).
Sam (sales): Request: please add instruction in the email for trial customers to escalate via priority@redwood.com with account ID. For inbound leads, can we auto-tag leads created in last 24h from eu-west and add note "possible latency"?
Maya (growth): Yep — we99ll pass tagging request to CRM: add lead tag "eu-west-latency" and route to CSM for any MQLs > $5k ARR.
Elena (marcom): Quick QA on copy. Two short status snippets to post (short + expanded):
Short: "We99re seeing elevated embeddings latency in eu-west. Engineers are working on it — no data loss. Updates every 30m."
Expanded (for status page): "We are currently investigating increased latency for embedding requests affecting a subset of customers in the eu-west region. Our team has identified network throughput issues and is implementing mitigation steps, including traffic shifts and scaling. We do not believe any customer data was impacted. We will post updates every 30 minutes or when the situation changes."
Liam (ops): Will add technical note to incident: "NVLink congestion observed; draining affected hosts and scaling up additional nodes."
Maya (growth): Who will approve final copy for email? Elena?
Elena (marcom): I99ll approve once ops confirms mitigation progress (snap at T+10m).
ops-bot: Automated update: mitigation complete on 3/5 affected hosts, latency trending down.
Sam (sales): :thumbsup: If latency still down at T+30m, go ahead and release queued webinar reminders.
Maya (growth): Noted — pausing Mailer send job now. Will resume if ops gives green at T+30m.
Elena (marcom): Good. After stabilization, follow-up plan: 1) post final status update on statuspage, 2) short email to affected customers summarizing impact and steps taken, 3) internal postmortem invite to stakeholders. Assigning owners: status page + email = Maya, lead routing/CRM tags = Sam, incident comms approval = Elena, ops updates = Liam.
Liam (ops): Copy. I99ll ping when we hit resolved and again with postmortem link.
Maya (growth): Adding note — for future, can we prep a one-click "pause promotions" toggle in Mailer for incidents? Saves time.
Elena (marcom): Agreed — backlog item. Thanks team.
ops-bot: Final automated update: incident resolved. All hosts back to normal. Incident ticket: https://incidents.internal/r/176012/summary
Elena (marcom): Great — Maya please post final message and send follow-up email template to Sam for review.
Maya (growth): Will do. Posting final status now.
Sam (sales): Thanks. Routing rule applied for recent leads.
Elena (marcom): Closing thread. Will coordinate postmortem invite later.
